nodes.description: Immutable IERC20 token being held by the TokenTimelock contract.
Immutable beneficiary address that receives the tokens after release.
Immutable timestamp after which the tokens can be released.
Constructor that validates releaseTime_ > block.timestamp and initializes token, beneficiary and release time.
View getter returning the held IERC20 token address.
View getter returning the beneficiary address.
View getter returning the release timestamp.
Transfers the whole token balance held by the contract to the beneficiary once block.timestamp >= releaseTime().
View function returning the token balance currently locked in the contract.
Block timestamp used as the release-time guard in the constructor and in release().
External token transfer (SafeERC20.safeTransfer -> low-level address.call) sending tokens to the beneficiary; can hand control to an arbitrary token contract.
External call token().balanceOf(address(this)) executed inside release() to compute the transferable amount.
External call token().balanceOf(address(this)) executed inside getLockedAmount().
Constructor parameter holding the ERC20 token address to be locked.
Constructor parameter holding the address allowed to withdraw the tokens.
Constructor parameter holding the timestamp at which release becomes possible.
Local variable in release() storing the contract token balance before transferring it.
Local variable in getLockedAmount() storing the contract token balance to return.

edges.reason: Constructor parameter token_ is written into the immutable state variable _token.
Constructor parameter beneficiary_ is written into the immutable state variable _beneficiary.
Constructor parameter releaseTime_ is written into the immutable state variable _releaseTime.
Constructor requires releaseTime_ > block.timestamp, making contract initialization dependent on the miner-controlled timestamp.
token() returns the _token state variable.
beneficiary() returns the _beneficiary state variable.
releaseTime() returns the _releaseTime state variable.
Release authorization is gated only by block.timestamp >= releaseTime(), a timestamp-dependent access condition.
releaseTime() result is consumed by the require guard inside release().
release() invokes the external token().balanceOf(address(this)) call.
The token instance stored in _token is the target of the balanceOf external call.
The value returned by token().balanceOf is stored in the local variable amount.
The local amount is used as the value forwarded in the safeTransfer external call.
beneficiary() result is passed as the recipient of the safeTransfer external call.
The _token instance is the contract on which the external safeTransfer/low-level call is executed.
release() performs the external transfer to the beneficiary.
The low-level external call inside safeTransfer transfers control to the token contract before release() completes, allowing reentrant calls back into release().
getLockedAmount() invokes the external token().balanceOf(address(this)) call.
The _token instance is the target of the balanceOf external call in getLockedAmount().
The value returned by token().balanceOf is stored in the local variable amount and returned.

normalization_plan.reason: token_ is a constructor parameter used only to initialize state; it can be merged into the constructor it belongs to.
beneficiary_ is a constructor parameter used only to initialize state; it can be merged into the constructor it belongs to.
releaseTime_ is a constructor parameter used only to initialize state and to evaluate the require guard; it can be merged into the constructor it belongs to.
release.amount is a transient local only carrying the balance into the safeTransfer unsafe operation; it can be merged into that unsafe operation.
getLockedAmount.amount is a transient local only returning the balance from getLockedAmount(); it can be merged into that function.
